scope: Save/load lot 6: slot, quick and level-entry files, META naming, the Load and Save menu rows, F5/F6, death to the Load menu and the level-entry snapshot. The slot rules, labels, commands and key guards were selected from the references below; the file layout, listing, notices and modals are replacement code over the lot 2 container. No original code was copied beyond the rules recorded in the provenance ledger.

references.purpose: CSavedGameInfo: the "<EMPTY SLOT>" default (25, 41), LoadInfo/SaveInfo over SLOT_CURRENT, SLOT_QUICK and the eight slots (67-233), ClearSaveSlot and CopySlot as whole-directory operations (245-414), SetSlotName's world title plus the " [%.15s]" ctime suffix and the bare Current name (429-453).
MAX_SAVESLOTS 8, MAX_SAVENAME, SLOT_CURRENT -2, SLOT_QUICK -1, SLOT_NONE and the SavedInfo record.
InitSavedGameSlots: RESTART and QUICKLOAD formatted with the Current and Quick names, then the eight slot names; OnCommand row 0 SLOT_CURRENT, row 1 SLOT_QUICK, row n slot n - 2.
InitSavedGameSlots: the eight slot names; OnCommand MenuSaveGame(row).
SetCurrentMenu with a top-level menu id; VK_ESCAPE on the top-level menu returns to the game in a world (1137-1170); the Single Player menu's in-world, single-player and alive Save guard (806-817).

OnCommandOn COMMAND_USE while dead: single player opens the Load menu as the top level, _DEMO the main menu (3488-3526); OnKeyDown F5 quicksave without pausing and "Quicksave...", F6 quickload and "Quickload..."
